description: This file defines the Developer controller class for the admin interface of an OpenCart-based project. It provides various developer tools such as clearing HTML, cache, theme files, generating SASS files, and autoloader files, with permission checks and JSON responses.

classes.name: Developer
classes.description: Controller class providing developer utility actions in the admin panel of an OpenCart project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language and renders the developer view with a user token.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Deletes HTML view files from the specified directory after permission check, returns JSON status.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Deletes cache files with prefix 'cache.' after permission check, returns JSON status.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Deletes theme directories in the cache directory after permission check, returns JSON status.

methods.name: sass_catalog
methods.description: Triggers a task to generate catalog SASS if the stylesheet exists, after permission check.

methods.name: sass_admin
methods.description: Triggers a task to generate admin SASS if the stylesheet exists, after permission check.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates a PHP autoloader file based on composer.json files in vendor directories, after permission check.
